🍗 Wing night

Step 2

Count the factors

1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36: 9

9 group sizes 🍗

1 is NOT prime. 2 IS prime

Q1

No calculator

[2 marks]

(a) Write down all the factors of 28. (b) Write down a prime number between 20 and 30.

Hint

Answer

Factors come in pairs.

Answer: (a) 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 28 (b) 23 or 29

click to solve →

Q2

No calculator

[2 marks]

(a) Write down the first five multiples of 8. (b) Amy says 57 is a prime number. Is she right? Explain.

Hint

Answer

A prime has exactly 2 factors.

Answer: (a) 8, 16, 24, 32, 40 (b) No: 57 = 3 × 19

click to solve →

No calculator

[2 marks]

(a) Write down all the prime numbers between 10 and 20. (b) Write down a multiple of 6 between 40 and 50.

Hint

Answer

A prime has exactly two factors.

Answer: (a) 11, 13, 17, 19 (b) 42 or 48

No calculator

[3 marks]

A shop has two ribbons. One is 48 cm long. The other is 72 cm long. Both are cut into pieces of the same length, with no ribbon left over. (a) What is the greatest possible length of each piece? (b) How many pieces are there altogether?

One lighthouse flashes every 16 seconds. Another flashes every 20 seconds. They flash together at 9 pm. When will they next flash together? How many times will they flash together in the next hour?

Answer
